scope: Read-only verification of the third-party author page inside a local sandboxed iframe. Application integration has separate tests.
author: Gorjan Jovanovski

sourceInspection.browserImplementation: JavaScript/canvas recreation, not emulation of the original Windows executable

limitations: The opaque sandbox disables localStorage. Entered named players revert to Tourist; embedded mode has no saved progress. The full-page author link enables normal profiles.
The author game exposes no parent pause or mute protocol. Its own controls work; removing the iframe ends the session.
Touch tests use emulated browser touchscreens; physical phone and audio-device acceptance is not claimed.
Game assets remain on the author host. Screenshots are attributed QA evidence of that remote page.
